title: A sharp-diffuse interface model for intermittent and isolated topological transitions
summary: We propose a hybrid sharp-diffuse interface representation for modeling intermittent and isolated topological transitions during Cahn-Hilliard phase coarsening. Away from topological events, the evolution is approximated by the Mullins-Sekerka sharp-interface limit system and computed using a boundary integral formulation. When diffuse transition layers overlap, a novel interface surgery algorithm resolves topology changes through a localized Cahn-Hilliard pseudo-time evolution, after which the sharp-interface calculation is resumed.
